def transform(grid):
    # A full-width nonzero row separates matching masks. Keep the overlap.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ta, br)]
            for ta, br in zip(top, bottom)]
